environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet with direct connectivity to RDS PostgreSQL instance. The application task role has s3:PutObject on audit-exports-prod/*. Database user has SELECT/INSERT on all tables. No query parameterization middleware. ALB forwards all POST /graphql requests directly to the container without inspection. Security groups allow 5432 from the app subnet CIDR.

config.db_permissions: SELECT, INSERT on all tables in appdb
